title: Detection of BRAF mutations from solid tumors using Tumorplex™ technology
author: Yo, Hay, et al.

steps.title: Amplify target region
steps.instruction: Amplify the region encompassing the BRAF V600E mutation using either cloned DNA or genomic DNA as template.

steps.title: Prepare PCR reaction mixture
steps.instruction: In a 0.2 ml PCR tube combine 25 µl Master Mix 2X buffer (Multiplex PCR Plus Kit, Qiagen, USA), 1 µl forward primer (10 µM) and 1 µl reverse primer (10 µM), add 1 µl or 2 µl template, and bring the volume to 50 µl with TE buffer. For cross‑reactivity assays use 1 µl of 0.6 ng/µl BRAF V600E clonal template, 1 µl of 0.55 ng/µl BRAF V600 clonal template, or 1 µl of each. For LLOD testing use 1 µl of the appropriate dilution from stock BRAF V600E gDNA (50 % allelic frequency, 9.36 ng/µl). For sensitivity determination use 1 µl of a clonal BRAF V600 dilution to challenge 1 µl of the previously identified LLOD.

steps.title: Run PCR thermal cycling
steps.instruction: Thermal‑cycle the PCR as follows: initial denaturation at 95 °C for 5 min; 35 cycles of 95 °C for 30 s, 55 °C for 90 s, and 72 °C for 30 s; final extension at 68 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Treat PCR product with UDG
steps.instruction: Add 5 units of Uracil‑DNA glycosylase to the completed PCR, incubate at 37 °C for 60 min, then inactivate the enzyme at 96 °C for 3 min.

steps.title: Purify amplicons with AMPure
steps.instruction: Clean the PCR amplicons using AMPure magnetic beads according to the manufacturer’s instructions (Beckman Coulter, USA).

steps.title: Set up sequencing reaction
steps.instruction: In a 10 µl sequencing reaction add 2.5 µl purified amplicon, 1 µl allele‑specific sequencing primer (BRAF V600E‑SP or V600‑SP) at 3.3 µM, 1 µl ABI PRISM BigDye Terminator Ready Reaction Mix v1.1 (Life Technologies, USA), 1.5 µl BigDye Terminator 5X Sequencing Buffer v1.1 (Life Technologies, USA), and 4 µl nuclease‑free water. For the level‑of‑sensitivity assay use 1.0 µM V600E‑SP and 0.5 µM V600‑SP.

steps.title: Perform sequencing thermal cycling
steps.instruction: Run the sequencing reaction for 25 cycles of 96 °C for 15 s followed by 60 °C for 2 min 45 s.

steps.title: Clean sequencing products
steps.instruction: Separate sequencing products from unincorporated dye terminators using CleanSEQ reagents according to the manufacturer’s protocol (Beckman Coulter, USA).

steps.title: Dry and resuspend samples
steps.instruction: Dry the cleaned sequencing products in a Speed Vac (DNA 120, ThermoSavant, USA) and re‑suspend in 20 µl Hi‑Di formamide. Dilute the re‑suspended sample 1:10 with Hi‑Di formamide before analysis.

steps.title: Analyze by capillary electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Run the diluted samples on an ABI PRISM Genetic Analyzer 3130. Detect BRAF V600E using Tumorplex™ analysis with Sequencing Analysis Software v6.0 (Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA).

steps.title: Assess primer specificity
steps.instruction: Test the mutant (V600E‑SP) and wild‑type (V600‑SP) sequencing primers with mutant and wild‑type templates in all combinations:

substeps.instruction: Mutant primer + mutant template → observe mutant signal only.
Mutant primer + wild‑type template → no signal.
Wild‑type primer + wild‑type template → observe wild‑type signal only.
Wild‑type primer + mutant template → no signal.
Both primers + mutant template → mutant signal only.
Both primers + wild‑type template → wild‑type signal only.

steps.title: Determine LLOD and sensitivity
steps.instruction: Prepare serial dilutions of the BRAF V600E template in human genomic DNA to generate a dilution containing 20 genome equivalents (GE) and confirm detection of the expected nucleotide sequence. Then create mixtures of V600E and V600 templates at decreasing mutant‑to‑wild‑type ratios down to 20 : 1 × 10⁷ (mutant : wild‑type) and assess detection of the mutant sequence.
